bfa6b5efa3975fb7.column_purpose: Reference to event.event_id, identifying the event the member attended. Airtable-style record ID (rec...).

b2b2d62186e89ebd.column_purpose: Reference to member.member_id, identifying the member who attended the event. Airtable-style record ID (rec...).

97d797abe2799674.column_purpose: Dollar amount allocated for this budget line (whole dollars, 10-350).

46daa5281a193f18.column_purpose: Primary key (Airtable-style record id) uniquely identifying each budget line; referenced by expense.link_to_budget.

416b94f3827d5722.column_purpose: Type of planned expense: Food, Advertisement, Parking, Speaker Gifts, Club T-Shirts.

57a10edfb79fba73.column_purpose: Status of the associated event: Open, Closed, or Planning. Likely a denormalized copy of the event's status.

6ffc7485c2a3bd01.column_purpose: Foreign key to event.event_id; the event this budget line belongs to.

f8e2f279e170326f.column_purpose: Dollars left in this budget line (amount minus spent); can go negative when spending exceeded the allocation.

c59a34bdd98b2778.column_purpose: Dollars spent against this budget line so far (0.0 for untouched lines).

54185894b81479dd.column_purpose: Date and time the event takes place (stored as text, ISO datetime). Range spans Sep 2019 - May 2020, i.e. an academic year.

e38c0f5edbdf7985.column_purpose: Primary key, Airtable-style record id ('rec' + 14 chars). Referenced by attendance.link_to_event and budget.link_to_event.

c8c833285f14aae8.column_purpose: Human-readable event title (e.g. 'Officers meeting - March', 'Habitat for Humanity').

de84a45558d929b6.column_purpose: Where the event is held: campus room ('MU 215'), campus stadiums, or street addresses; sometimes 'Various locations' or null.

7a89b3067f7804a2.column_purpose: Free-text description/eligibility notes, e.g. volunteer opportunity details, attendance rules, who may attend.

b3ea6f7957c18499.column_purpose: Event category: Meeting, Guest Speaker, Game, Community Service, Social, Election, Budget, and one more (8 distinct).

3f6dd7f11fef3f2e.column_purpose: Whether the expense was approved. Stored as text 'true'/'false'; all non-null values are 'true' (31 of 32 rows, one null).

2aac3e1edf6f8af7.column_purpose: Monetary amount of the expense in dollars (range 6.00–295.12, mean ~65.19).

9226d82e58240599.column_purpose: Date the expense was incurred/paid, between 2019-08-20 and 2019-11-19.

43588eff0485df88.column_purpose: Free-text description of what was purchased (e.g., Pizza, Posters, Club shirts, Parking, snacks like water/chips/cookies).

91b8ad4e1f0fd4d7.column_purpose: Primary key; unique record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) for the expense row.

41bb27c76b564f2f.column_purpose: Foreign key to budget.budget_id, assigning the expense to a budget category (e.g., Advertisement, Food, Parking). Many expenses to one budget line.

d0fbd98b9283ec10.column_purpose: Foreign key to member.member_id, the member who submitted/incurred the expense; only 3 distinct members account for all 32 expenses.

ee857ed629fe9582.column_purpose: Monetary amount received, in dollars. Mostly $50 membership dues; one-off larger amounts ($200, $1000, $3000) correspond to fundraising, sponsorship, and school funding entries.

98db4462de61c30f.column_purpose: Date the money was received (stored as text, ISO date format). All entries fall in Sep–Oct 2019, consistent with a semester of dues collection.

a65452e01add657f.column_purpose: Primary key; unique Airtable-style record ID ('rec...') for each income entry.

fa9b6517b5c53e50.column_purpose: Reference to member.member_id — the member who paid the dues or secured the income. Nullable (some income, e.g. school funding, is not tied to a member).

b510912796fcd40e.column_purpose: Optional free-text note describing the income; present only on the three non-dues entries (ad revenue, Student Government funding, donations for speaker gifts).

a4f36cbc28a0f7c5.column_purpose: Category of income: 'Dues' (33 rows), plus one each of 'Fundraising', 'Sponsorship', and 'School Appropration' (sic — likely 'School Appropriation').

a3cade938c80b627.column_purpose: The name of the college the major belongs to (e.g., College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences, College of Humanities and Social Sciences). 8 distinct colleges.

eda7ff5e740f6b3d.column_purpose: The name of the academic department or school administering the major (e.g., Applied Economics Department, School of Accountancy). 47 distinct departments.

f7cf7ac5e7b82452.column_purpose: Primary key; unique Airtable-style record ID (prefixed 'rec') identifying each major. Referenced by member.link_to_major, so each member's major points to a row here.

6e571a75ca3169e3.column_purpose: The human-readable name of the academic major/degree program (e.g., Accounting, History, Environmental Engineering). Unique per row.

7920405ed03e7ae9.column_purpose: Member's email address, firstname.lastname@lpu.edu format; unique per member.

c3ecf0b33c74ffb7.column_purpose: Reference to the member's academic major in the major lookup table (Airtable record ID). Nullable — some members have no declared major.

01b8d1e36e7b2c7c.column_purpose: Primary key; Airtable-style record ID uniquely identifying each member. Referenced by attendance, expense, and income tables.

10f8ee4d1218b02b.column_purpose: Member's phone number; mixed formats (some (XXX) XXX-XXXX, many XXX-555-XXXX, i.e., fictional 555 numbers).

8f0d12d7861cd968.column_purpose: Member's standing/role in the organization: Member, Inactive, or an officer role (President, Secretary, Treasurer; a 6th distinct value exists but is not shown).

91b487b8f5b18163.column_purpose: Member's t-shirt size: Small, Medium, Large, or X-Large.

b9f33f904ee016ec.column_purpose: Member's home ZIP code (US postal code), referencing the zip_code lookup table. Note some values appear zero-truncated (e.g., 1020, 8021 likely 01020/08021) since stored as integer.

149da3c816620716.column_purpose: Primary city or town name served by the ZIP code (USPS preferred place name).

f40b8e6187ae8321.column_purpose: County (or county-equivalent such as borough, municipio, or census area) containing the ZIP code.

21f49d8d37893666.column_purpose: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation (includes territories, e.g. PR).

d0ebd452b6f1bb8c.column_purpose: Full state or territory name corresponding to short_state.

5340ecd411db8f37.column_purpose: USPS ZIP code classification: Standard (general delivery area), PO Box (post-office-box-only ZIP), Unique (single high-volume address such as a company or building).

6b7b45ee999cdb0f.column_purpose: US postal ZIP code (5-digit), primary key of the table; referenced by member.zip.
